evals.prompt: explore today's issues and PRs in the TeamBrain repo (libz-renlab-ai/TeamBrain) before 9am Beijing please. tell me what had happened since yesterday 9am
evals.expected_output: A categorized 24h-window delta report: PRs merged / created / closed-without-merge / still-open + Issues created / closed / open-in-window, regrouped by theme (Feature N / Frontend / Symphony / FIXEDFLOW / m5 / bugfix / CI / docs), ending with a 'still open / 待办' table that flags each open PR/issue and a concrete next-step recommendation. Duck voice wrapper (呷呷~ / 鸭鸭 / ASCII 鸭子). Window math must convert 09:00 +0800 → 01:00 UTC and use jq client-side filtering to exact UTC endpoints (not just gh's date-granularity --search). `gh pr list` and `gh issue list` (not `gh search prs`).

assertions.text: Window endpoints stated explicitly in UTC (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DDT01:00:00Z')
Uses `gh pr list --search` and `gh issue list --search` (NOT `gh search prs` / `gh search issues`)
Reports all six buckets: PRs merged + PRs created + PRs closed-without-merge + PRs still open + Issues created + Issues closed + Issues open-in-window
Theme grouping is present (≥3 of: Feature N / Frontend / Symphony / FIXEDFLOW / m5 / bugfix / CI / docs)
'Still open / 待办' section present, lists ≥1 specific open PR or issue with a concrete next-step recommendation (e.g. driver-dispatchable, /review PASS, etc.)
Duck voice wrapper present: at least one of 呷呷~ / 鸭鸭 / ASCII 鸭子 / (>ω<) anywhere in the output
Ends with `result:` line stating the headline (per background-session contract)
